name: decisions_write

ops.description: Operations, one flat object each, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

class.description: Decision class (for example question or deviation); it decides who may answer. [ops: raise]

question.description: The question, at most 500 characters. [ops: raise]

options.description: 1 to 8 choices, each {key, label, consequence}. [ops: raise]

recommended.description: Key of the recommended option. [ops: raise]

links.description: Up to 10 {kind, ref} pointers; kind is item, note, doc, commit or url. [ops: raise]

context.description: Background for the answerer, at most 1000 characters. [ops: raise]

dedupeKey.description: Re-raising the same key returns the open or answered decision instead of a new one. [ops: raise]

itemId.description: Item id: UUID or 8-32 hex. [ops: raise]

runId.description: Run id: UUID or 8-32 hex. [ops: raise]

rootId.description: The root item the run belongs to. Item id: UUID or 8-32 hex. [ops: raise]

block.description: true: also block itemId as awaiting_decision in the same unit. [ops: raise]

decisionId.description: Decision id: UUID or 8-32 hex. [ops: delegate, withdraw]

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return each operation's parameters and errors; nothing runs.

seatToken.description: Run seat token; omit when not seated.

description: Raise, delegate and withdraw decisions. Each op needs a root in scope and the runs capability (delegate: decide). Only the answerers of a decision's class delegate it; withdraw: its raiser or the run token of its run. Result: the decision. Call with describe:true for parameters and errors.
